record: Mountain Top Hotel initial environmental examination, §4.11, Myanmar Environmental Conservation Department
facts: The boulder is about 7.6 m high and bears the pagoda, about 7.3 m high. The boulder rests on a natural rock platform. Devotees reach the boulder via a bridge.

record: Myanmar Ministry of Information site account, 16 February 2024
facts: The shrine is a small 7.3 m pagoda on gilded granite. Gold-toned railings frame a paved terrace around the shrine.
